groups.name: Semantic landmark elements used
groups.definition: Does the page structure content with HTML5 semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, section, article, aside, footer) rather than generic divs?

groups.name: Main landmark present
groups.definition: Is the page content wrapped in a main element?

groups.name: Clean sequential heading hierarchy
groups.definition: Does the page have a clean, properly nested heading outline (h1 then h2 sections then h3 items, without skipped levels)?

groups.name: Single h1 hero headline
groups.definition: Does the page have exactly one h1 holding the main headline?

groups.name: Missing h1 in heading outline
groups.definition: Is the page lacking an h1, with the top-level heading being an h2 or lower?

groups.name: Descriptive image alt text
groups.definition: Do images carry meaningful descriptive alt text (with none missing)?

groups.name: Images mostly have empty alt
groups.definition: Do content images mostly have empty alt attributes?

groups.name: Lean minimal markup
groups.definition: Is the markup lean, with few scripts, classes, inline styles and no external stylesheets?

groups.name: Minimal head meta tags
groups.definition: Does the head include only standard meta tags such as charset, viewport and description?

groups.name: Real button and label elements
groups.definition: Does the page use native button elements (and labels) for actions and form inputs?

groups.name: Blockquote/cite quote markup
groups.definition: Are quotes marked up with semantic elements such as blockquote, cite, figure/figcaption or q?

groups.name: Address element for contact
groups.definition: Are contact details wrapped in an address element?

groups.name: Spans for small labels
groups.definition: Are spans or small/strong/b inline tags used for small labels and secondary text?

groups.name: Native dialog login
groups.definition: Is the login a single native dialog element containing a form?

groups.name: Lang attribute without region
groups.definition: Does the html lang attribute name only a language without a region?

groups.name: List markup for link groups
groups.definition: Are navigation menus and link groups built as ul/li lists?

groups.name: Descriptive page title
groups.definition: Does the page title use a full organization name or brand plus tagline rather than a generic label?

groups.name: Live text headings not images
groups.definition: Are headings live styled text rather than images of lettering?

groups.name: ARIA attributes present
groups.definition: Does the page include ARIA attributes for accessibility?

groups.name: Struck-through original prices use semantic s elements.
groups.definition: Struck-through original prices use semantic s elements.
